lines.text: Some people told Jesus about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.
Jesus said those Galileans were no worse sinners than the others, and told them to fast or perish.
Jesus said the eighteen killed when the tower of Babel collapsed were no more sinful than others in Jerusalem.
A man found no fruit on his fig tree for three years and said to cut it down.
The keeper asked to leave the tree alone one more year, to dig around it and fertilize it.
